At -7.15% from 82.50 that is 2.4 daily ranges on a roughly 3% mover, inside the 3.0 I default to, about 118 USD or 103 EUR of risk and 1.0% of book, comfortably inside my -15% mandate stop. Dated 10-15 rather than 09-30 so a day-one rail is not killed by the month-end expiry cluster — the lesson I wrote down on ABN and STAN and am applying without being re-taught it. FX stance: written in dollars, so a firming euro would stop me in USD and compound the loss in EUR; I accept that because the dollar leg is the point of the position, and a level 7% away is far enough that FX drift is not what trips it.
